blocks.prompt: 2. A girl has 9 marbles. There are 4 red marbles, 3 blue, and 2 green marbles. If she arranges them in a row, then find in how many different arrangements she can make take all at time?
blocks.explanation:
Ek hi rang ke marbles dekhne mein bilkul aik jaise hain, is liye un ki aapas mein jagah badalne se koi nayi line nahi banti.
Find kya karna hai? Saare 9 marbles ki kitni mukhtalif lines (rows) ban sakti hain.
Plan: 'objects not all different' wala formula lagana hai, bilkul letters wale sawalon ki tarah.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 9 marbles: 4 red (aik jaise), 3 blue (aik jaise), 2 green (aik jaise).
Humein find karna hai: sab marbles ek row mein kitne tareeqon se lag sakte hain.
Tareeqa: \(\dfrac{n!}{n_1!\,n_2!\,n_3!}\), jahan \(n = 9\) kul marbles, aur \(n_1 = 4\), \(n_2 = 3\), \(n_3 = 2\) har rang ki ginti hai.

Kul ginti check karein
\[4 + 3 + 2 = 9\]
Kyun: Har marble kisi ek rang ka hai, to groups ka jama kul marbles ke barabar hona chahiye. Yeh chhota sa check ghalat parhe hue sawal se bachata hai.

Formula lagayen
\[\dfrac{9!}{4!\,3!\,2!} = \dfrac{9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4!}{4!\,3!\,2!}\]
\[= \dfrac{15120}{6 \cdot 2} = \dfrac{15120}{12}\]
\[= 1260\]
Kyun: Agar har marble alag hota to \(9!\) rows banti. Lekin 4 red aapas mein \(4!\) tareeqon se badal sakte hain aur row wahi rehti hai; isi tarah blue \(3!\) aur green \(2!\). Is liye in sab se divide kiya. Hisaab aasaan karne ke liye \(9!\) ko \(4!\) tak khol kar cancel kiya.
Dhyan dein: Sirf \(9!\) likh dena (362880) ghalat hai, kyunke yeh aik jaise marbles ko alag alag gin leta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{362880}{24 \cdot 6 \cdot 2} = \dfrac{362880}{288} = 1260 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Poori value \(9! = 362880\) ko \(4!\,3!\,2! = 288\) se divide kiya to bhi 1260 aaya.
